full_judgment:
Muhammad Imman Ali J. This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 18.08.2021 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.25842 of 2021. 

 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that the informant along with 4 (four) others paid Tk.35,00,000/-(thirty five laid]) to one Monir who was an employee of the Office of M.P. Paplu to go to Kuwait. The informant and others reached Kuwait on different dates. Monir told them that they would receive 120 Kuwaiti Dinar monthly before leaving for Kuwait. But when they reached Kuwait they were jobless for four months. Subsequently they got job at a monthly salary of 100 Kuwaiti Dinar for 16 hours duty in a day. Hence, the informant lodged First Information Report (FIR) with the Officer-in-Charge of Motijheel Police Station alleging offence under the মানব পাচার প্রতিরোধ ও দমন আইন, ২০১২। 

 9. Our above views shall have no bearing upon the trial Court when considering the merit of the case. Accordingly, the criminal petition for leave to appeal is dispose of.
